correctness.rationale: Reconstructed primitive-word indicator via divisor Möbius inversion and subspace orthogonality: W_n(b)=sum_{d|n} mu(n/d)2^d 1_{H_d}(b). With r=rad(n),m=n/r only d=mt with t|r survive; b outside H_m has W=0, inside H_m the isolated d=m term is mu(r)2^m modulo 2^(m+1), giving exact v2=m. The explicit b=e_0+e_m (valid n>=2m) isolates magnitude 2^m, and Fourier support H_m entails translation stabilizer V_m and convolution rank 2^(n-m), pseudoinverse norm 2^(-m). Direct independent brute force primitive indicators plus integer Walsh butterfly checked all multipliers/support/gap for n=2..9; the universal conclusion rests on the proof, not that finite check.
